summary: Adds a partial UNIQUE index on library_documents (community_id, file_hash) for category 'vendor_invoice' rows with a hash, so the canonical AP intake's one-document-per-invoice-PDF identity is database-enforced (Issue #9). No data is created or changed.

preflight.name: the index does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND indexname = 'uq_library_documents_vendor_invoice_hash'

preflight.name: no duplicate vendor_invoice (community_id, file_hash) groups (the index would fail to build)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT community_id, file_hash FROM library_documents WHERE category = 'vendor_invoice' AND file_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY community_id, file_hash HAVING count(*) > 1) d

expected_changes: Adds 1 partial unique index: uq_library_documents_vendor_invoice_hash on library_documents (community_id, file_hash) WHERE category = 'vendor_invoice' AND file_hash IS NOT NULL.
No rows are inserted, updated or deleted.

verify.name: the partial unique index exists
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND indexname = 'uq_library_documents_vendor_invoice_hash' AND indexdef ILIKE '%UNIQUE%' AND indexdef ILIKE '%vendor_invoice%'
